title: EZTrade
description: Easy-to-use Trade system with full Geyser/Bedrock compatibility
body:
# EZTrade

A lightweight Paper plugin that makes trading between players fast, safe, and effortless.

What is EZTrade?

EZTrade provides a clean, intuitive trade system that prevents scams and keeps transactions secure—all with simple commands and zero unnecessary complexity. Say goodbye to risky item drops and unreliable player-to-player trades.

✨ Key Features

Secure Trading System - Both players must confirm before any items are exchanged, preventing scams and accidental trades.

Simple Commands - Intuitive commands make trading accessible to everyone, no complicated setup required.

Scam Prevention - Built-in safeguards ensure both parties see exactly what they're getting before confirming.

Lightweight Performance - Minimal resource usage means no server lag or performance impact.
Clean Interface - User-friendly GUI that makes trading straightforward and hassle-free.

🎯 Why EZTrade?

Traditional Minecraft trading relies on dropping items or honor systems, which often leads to scams, misunderstandings, and lost items. EZTrade solves this by providing a structured, secure trading environment where both players can review and confirm trades before they happen.

Perfect for:

Survival servers with player economies
Community servers that encourage player interaction
Any server that wants to provide safe trading without complex economy plugins

🚀 Getting Started

Simply install the plugin, and players can start trading securely with straightforward commands. No complex configuration needed—it works right out of the box
